summary: Consumers replace Text with Typography compound presets and remove direct typography utility overrides from generated UI.
steps: Replace Text display, headline, title, body, caption, and label usage with the matching Typography compound preset.
Use Typography.Mono or Typography.Code only for identifiers, code, timestamps, and other deliberately technical values.
Remove consumer-authored font family, size, weight, line-height, and tracking utilities where Typography owns the role.
consumers: AI-generated and hand-authored En UI consumers that currently compose typography with raw utility classes.
